name: XSIJ
fix_description: autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens is called on every sell with no cooldown. Each sell burns a fixed removePoolAmount from the pair and syncs, allowing attackers to repeatedly sell small amounts to drain the pair. Add a time-based cooldown (e.g., once per hour) or cap cumulative burns per period.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short multi-step price/accounting manipulation using a flash loan, a swap into a fee-on-transfer token, repeated tiny transfers to the pair to push pool state past a threshold, and a swap back for profit. It is not deeply complex, but it requires understanding the token/pair-specific behavior and why desynchronizing the pool balance triggers the vulnerable logic, so it is beyond a trivial single-pattern bug.
